rules.name: Modbus Command Injection
rules.description: Industrial Control Systems and Operational Technology attack detection
rules.query: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4688 | where NewProcessName contains "modbus" or CommandLine contains "command" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, Account, NewProcessName | where count_ > 5 // AZ-ICS_OT-107
